name: Metamagic Rod, Familiar
body:
Aura strong (no school); Price varies: lesser 14,000 gp, standard 54,000 gp, greater 121,500 gp; CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that affect his familiar as though using the Familiar Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Rod, Familiar Spell; Cost varies: lesser 7,000 gp, standard 27,000 gp, greater 60,750 gp
